text:
lauren_cs: Morning — Ironfold day0 check-in. Blockers: they can't get audit logs into Splunk and our KMS rotation is hitting AccessDenied. Also customer asked for approved egress IPs for their firewall. Can infra help provide validation steps? :wave:

sanjay_se: Looking. Can you paste the KMS error text? Is it 'AccessDeniedException' or 'NotFound'?

lauren_cs: AccessDenied. Message: "User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ironfold-infra-role/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Encrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/abcd-ef01-2345"

maya_infra: That's usually a key policy or grant issue. We'll need to add Redwood's proxy role as a principal. Sample key policy snippet below — paste into their CMK policy and test rotate again.

maya_infra: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodProxy",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-kms-proxy"
      },
      "Action": [
        "kms:Encrypt",
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:GenerateDataKey"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

eli_security: Also confirm the CMK alias — they created alias/ironfold-prod but our Terraform expects alias/ironfold-app-prod. Alias mismatch will cause automated rotations to fail. Small but common gotcha.

lauren_cs: Got it. I'll ask them to rename alias or we can update our mapping.

maya_infra: For egress: current NAT public IPs used by the private deployment are 3.21.45.73, 3.21.45.74, 18.204.12.9. Customer wants CIDRs; we can provide /32s for whitelisting but confirm they only need outbound to Splunk and S3.

lauren_cs: They said Splunk HEC + S3 for audit buckets. Also asked for an endpoint health-check for Splunk — can we give a quick curl they can run from their forwarder?

sanjay_se: Yep — test command below (replace <token>):
```bash
curl -k -H 'Authorization: Splunk <token>' \
  https://splunk.hec.redwood-ops/services/collector/event \
  -d '{"event":"ping"}'
```
If 200 — HEC reachable. If 403/401 — token or network blocked.

ironfold_ops: (Customer) Thanks — running the curl now after we update the alias. Will report back in ~10m.

lauren_cs: Quick note on audit: our compliance team needs S3 audit retention >= 90 days for this account. Please confirm lifecycle policy once bucket exists.

eli_security: I'll add a checklist to the ticket: CMK alias, key policy, grant for redwood proxy, S3 lifecycle >=90d, Splunk HEC reachability, and firewall /32 list.

opsbot: Incident created: CS-1129 ironfold onboarding KMS/egress/splunk. Assigned to maya_infra, priority P2.

lauren_cs: Also flagging renewal risk: setting to MEDIUM until audit logs are flowing and rotation validated — capturing for AM. We'll revisit after customer confirms curl and key alias fix. :warning:

maya_infra: I'll push the policy change and follow up here with exact /32s in the next 30m.

ironfold_ops: (Customer) Update: curl returns 401 still. Token/HEC looks like the issue. We'll rotate token and retry.

sanjay_se: Ok — keep me posted. If token rotate doesn't work, we can open a Splunk support ticket and share tcpdump sample.

lauren_cs: Thanks everyone. Tentative follow-up call 10am PST tomorrow if still open. Added action items to CS-1129. :calendar:
